value.name: id
value.purpose: singleton row; application code ensures exactly one row exists

value.name: quiet_hours_start
value.purpose: hour of day 0-23 when the quiet window begins; emails are deferred if the current hour is within the window

value.name: quiet_hours_end
value.purpose: hour of day 0-23 when the quiet window ends; deferred batches resume at this hour

value.name: notify_quota
value.purpose: maximum subscribers to notify per restock event dispatch run; remainder waits for the next restock

value.name: conversion_window_days
value.purpose: number of days after a notification is sent within which a purchase counts as a conversion

value.name: email_subject_template
value.purpose: merchant-configured email subject line template, may include placeholders for product name and item details

value.name: email_body_template
value.purpose: merchant-configured email body template, may include placeholders for product name, item details, and unsubscribe URL

value.name: item_key
value.purpose: item that became available, matches waitlist_entries.item_key

value.name: inventory_item_external_id
value.purpose: Shopify inventory item id from the webhook used for dedup key

value.name: inventory_level_updated_at
value.purpose: value of updated_at from the inventory_levels/update webhook payload; used as the dedup key partner so two re-deliveries of the same event share the same value and the unique constraint prevents a duplicate restock_event row

value.name: status
value.purpose: lifecycle: pending (awaiting dispatch), dispatching (job in progress), completed (all eligible subscribers notified for this event)
